"""Find the stretches of opening hours that nobody is covering."""

import hourglass.errors
import hourglass.merging
import hourglass.models
import hourglass.parsing


def uncovered_gaps(worked, opening):
    """One label such as 'gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)' per uncovered stretch.

    Raises ProjectError when any worked span falls outside opening hours.
    """
    # reject anything that sticks out of opening hours
    for span in worked:
        if span.start < opening.start or span.end > opening.end:
            raise hourglass.errors.ProjectError(
                "worked span "
                + hourglass.parsing.format_span(span)
                + " is outside opening hours "
                + hourglass.parsing.format_span(opening)
            )

    labels = []
    cursor = opening.start
    # walk the merged spans and note each hole before them
    for span in hourglass.merging.merge_spans(worked):
        if span.start > cursor:
            labels.append(_label(cursor, span.start))
        cursor = span.end
    if cursor < opening.end:
        labels.append(_label(cursor, opening.end))
    return labels


def _label(start, end):
    gap = hourglass.models.Span(start, end)
    return (
        "gap "
        + hourglass.parsing.format_span(gap)
        + " ("
        + str(gap.minutes)
        + " min)"
    )
# end of file
EOF
cat > tests/test_gaps.py <<'EOF'
import unittest

import hourglass.errors
import hourglass.gaps
import hourglass.parsing


def spans(*texts):
    result = []
    # parse each range text
    for text in texts:
        result.append(hourglass.parsing.parse_span(text))
    return result


OPEN = hourglass.parsing.parse_span("09:00-17:00")


class UncoveredGapsTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_gap_in_the_middle(self):
        found = hourglass.gaps.uncovered_gaps(
            spans("09:00-12:00", "13:00-17:00"), OPEN
        )
        self.assertEqual(found, ["gap 12:00-13:00 (60 min)"])

    def test_no_one_working_is_one_big_gap(self):
        found = hourglass.gaps.uncovered_gaps([], OPEN)
        self.assertEqual(found, ["gap 09:00-17:00 (480 min)"])

    def test_full_coverage_has_no_gaps(self):
        found = hourglass.gaps.uncovered_gaps(
            spans("09:00-13:00", "12:00-17:00"), OPEN
        )
        self.assertEqual(found, [])

    def test_gaps_at_both_ends_and_unsorted_input(self):
        found = hourglass.gaps.uncovered_gaps(
            spans("14:00-15:00", "10:00-12:30"), OPEN
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            found,
            [
                "gap 09:00-10:00 (60 min)",
                "gap 12:30-14:00 (90 min)",
                "gap 15:00-17:00 (120 min)",
            ],
        )

    def test_touching_spans_leave_no_gap(self):
        found = hourglass.gaps.uncovered_gaps(
            spans("09:00-12:00", "12:00-17:00"), OPEN
        )
        self.assertEqual(found, [])

    def test_span_outside_opening_hours_raises(self):
        with self.assertRaises(hourglass.errors.ProjectError):
            hourglass.gaps.uncovered_gaps(spans("08:00-12:00"), OPEN)
        with self.assertRaises(hourglass.errors.ProjectError):
            hourglass.gaps.uncovered_gaps(spans("16:00-18:00"), OPEN)
# end of file
EOF
